notes: Two «ح» branches: the first ends at ابن شهاب; the second runs through الزهري to عائشة. Both name Zuhri; they are not merged (rule 9), and no names follow the last «ح» for the first branch, so there is no shared tail.
«قال سمعت الزهري، قال سمعت عروة ...»: Zuhri heard four co-transmitters, who give the report from Aisha: one level.
«وكل حدثني طائفة من الحديث» is a remark about the four sources; the story of the Prophet and Usayd is part of Aisha's account, not a link.
